scheme_name: Scheme of Death Benefit for Weavers & Artisans of West Bengal
other_conditions: The deceased artisan/weaver must have died on or after 7 March 2024 (the date of notification).
The claimant must not have availed any other death benefit scheme provided by the State Government.
The application must be submitted within 3 months of the death of the artisan/weaver.
The claimant must produce a certificate from the local BDO confirming eligibility for the claim.
benefits_summary: A lump‑sum payment of ₹2,00,000 is provided to the family of each deceased weaver or artisan.
documents_required: Application in prescribed format with all requisite enclosures
Certificate from the local BDO confirming eligibility for the claim
